title: Submit immutable result versions bound to attempts and exact workspace snapshots
goal: Turn a producer’s completed work into a durable candidate whose authorship, before/after state and artifacts remain available for independent verification and later recovery.
scope: Implement the Plan/WorkItem storage and validated one-item graph needed to attach actual production to criterion targets, dependencies, write paths and attempts. A fixed explicit initial graph is sufficient here; model-generated planning/revision is W1-0011.

Implement Attempt Pending/Submitted/Accepted/Rejected(reason)/Abandoned and immutable ResultVersion submission with WorkItem, actual producer/profile, before/after Snapshot references, Artifact path/digest set and summary. Validate ownership against the admitted assignment and its workspace rather than trusting a response’s claimed author.

Capture before state before production and submit after state only when attributable cessation/non-execution facts permit a stable snapshot of that scope. Keep rejected/abandoned candidates and accepted work addressable; new candidates get new identities and cannot rewrite evidence links. A grant revocation or parent exit alone is not a stable-result signal.

Persist ResultSubmitted and the work/attempt transition through kernel operations, expose result bytes/references to a later checker, and keep accepted WorkItem references separate from a producer’s submission claim.
acceptance: A real temporary workspace producer submits a candidate through the runtime; reopening the journal retrieves its exact before/after bytes, producer/profile, criterion targets and artifact digests after later workspace edits.
A foreign assignment, changed digest, missing snapshot or unresolved write effect cannot submit a valid candidate. Process completion alone leaves the work unaccepted.

A rejected/abandoned attempt remains inspectable, and revocation does not mutate any stored candidate or accepted WorkItem reference. A retry creates a distinct attempt and result instead of overwriting history.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.3 (Plan, WorkItem), 3.4 (Attempt, ResultVersion), 4 (WorkspaceGuard), A6/A10/A11 and R-16. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-domain/src/{plan,result}.rs and crates/ymp-kernel/src/results.rs. W1-0005 supplies immutable snapshots/content and W1-0017 supplies attributable producer completion/cessation. Define the minimal explicit one-item Plan/WorkItem needed to submit a real result; model planning/revision belongs to W1-0011/W3-0004.

Submission validates actual assignment/workspace/producer/profile ownership and records a fresh Attempt/ResultVersion. No submission or process completion is acceptance. W1-0009 checks these candidates, W1-0010 independently accepts/rejects them and discharges artifact commitments.

Retain snapshot bytes and non-selected/rejected/abandoned versions. A retry cannot overwrite results/evidence and unresolved writing cannot yield a stable after snapshot. Use the durable store from W1-0016; no previous-iteration migration is required.
